name: Single cell atlas of the human retina - all cells - scRNA-seq
description: This atlas is an integrated collection of over 260K cells, derived from single-cell RNA-seq data of the human retina. These retinal cells have been categorized into 10 major classes.

labels.name: Tonsillar Squamous Cell Carcinoma,Metastatic Malignant Neoplasm in the Brain

labelsets.name: cell_type
labelsets.description: This is the ingested cell type for the atlas, based on scRNA-seq datasets.

labels.name: retinal rod cell
labels.rationale: Rod is annotated by the marker PDE6A.

labels.name: Mueller cell
labels.rationale: Muller glia cells are annotated by the marker RLBP1.

labels.name: retinal bipolar neuron
labels.rationale: Bipolar cells are annotated by canonical markers, OTX2 and VSX2.

labels.name: glycinergic amacrine cell
labels.rationale: Glycinergic ACs are annotated by SLC6A9.

labels.name: GABAergic amacrine cell
labels.rationale: GABAergic ACs are annotated by GAD1 and/or GAD2.

labels.name: retinal cone cell
labels.rationale: Cone cells are annotated by ARR3.

labels.name: S cone cell
labels.rationale: S Cone (short wavelength - cone) is one type of Cone cells. The marker for S Cone is OPN1SW.

labels.name: starburst amacrine cell
labels.rationale: Starburst ACs are annotated by the marker CHAT.

labels.name: H1 horizontal cell
labels.rationale: H1 type is annotated by LHX1.

labels.name: H2 horizontal cell
labels.rationale: H2 horizontal cells are annotated by ISL1.

labels.name: midget ganglion cell of retina
labels.rationale: Midget RGCs are annotated by TBR1 and TPBG.

labels.name: microglial cell
labels.rationale: Microglia cells are annotated by the marker CD74.

labels.name: parasol ganglion cell of retina
labels.rationale: Parasol RGC has two types, i.e., OFF parasol RGC (by FABP4) and ON parasol RGC (by CHRNA2).

labels.name: retinal pigment epithelial cell
labels.rationale: RPE type is annotated by RPE65.
